description: Two event handlers that do NOT fire E-ERROR-002. `onclick=risky` is a function REFERENCE, not a call. `onclick={ risky() !{ | .Empty :> @r = 7 } }` handles the call with an exhaustive `!{}`. Clicking the guarded button runs the arm: @r lands 7, which shows the one-statement guard is emitted rather than dropped.
rationale: §19.4.3 — a call handled with `!{}` satisfies the handling requirement, and a reference is not a call (§41.14.3 REQUIRES `<formFor onsubmit=fn/>`'s reference to be failable). §5.2.3 — no statement of a handler SHALL be dropped, so the guard's arm has to run.
